user_questions.question: 1) What points thresholds map to each tier (Explorer, Insider, Pronto Plus, Pronto One, Pronto Elite)? No threshold config exists in the org; recommendation: give fixed ranges. 2) What is the 'points balance': net points (Earn minus Redeem, since Transaction_Type__c has Earn and Redeem) or lifetime earned points? Recommendation: net. 3) Should tiers go down when the balance drops, and should the tier be recalculated on transaction delete as well as insert/update? Recommendation: yes to both.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Net points (Earn minus Redeem across all Loyalty Transactions): Explorer 0-999, Insider 1000-4999, Pronto Plus 5000-9999, Pronto One 10000-24999, Pronto Elite 25000+. Recalculate on every loyalty transaction insert/update/delete. Tiers can go down.

skill_friction: The skill says to ask 'after D1' but also to verify in step 3 before resolving forks in step 4; the order of D2 vs the question message is not stated. I asked after D2 and verification, which made the options better grounded but the rule is ambiguous.

AskCoworker's I proposal was architecturally wrong (after-trigger reading a roll-up that recalculates only after the child's after-triggers; claimed flows do not fire on delete). The skill's table says 'wrong details in proposals: fix from evidence, record in Section 8' but does not say whether replacing the whole architecture counts as a fix or requires resending I; I fixed it myself and sent the corrected inventory in R and T.

Order-of-execution facts (roll-up recalculation saves the parent through before-save flows; roll-up over a same-object formula) cannot be verified with allowed commands and are load-bearing; the skill only offers the 'assumption (documented platform behavior)' tag, with no guidance on whether that is acceptable for the core mechanism.

FlowTest for a before-save flow whose input is a read-only roll-up field: unclear whether Flow Tests can set it; spec-format mandates FlowTest or manual checks for flow-only changes but gives no rule for when a FlowTest row should be Conditional.

AskCoworker repeatedly cited 'prior session' facts and marked FLS grants for unexposed new fields as blocking; the skill handles prior-session facts but not AskCoworker's blocking/non-blocking classifications, which I overrode per the least-access content rule.
